question: Are there elements, other than pitch, that can potentially result in out of key converted singing?
title: PitchNet: Unsupervised Singing Voice Conversion with Pitch Adversarial Network
answer_rationale: The evidence indicates that elements other than pitch, such as singer-invariant phoneme representation and speaker embedding, are critical in singing voice conversion. Errors in these components can lead to out-of-key results independently of pitch inaccuracies, as highlighted in the retrieved documents.
